title: An item whose code reads backlog state checks every path that changes it
goal: Planning (kb-backlog) adds, for an item whose code reads an item's status or presence, a check for each way the state changes (done, drop inside and outside a sprint, close, release), and backlog.py check warns when such an item's checks name fewer. Answers SP-jtfo4ael's retrospective: kbdecide sweep passed its checks while missing items dropped outside a sprint (BG-qks4ikyr).
